# Pack vectors.
#
# The first five lines were emitted by the AUTHORITY as it stood before this
# module existed: freenet-contracts `block::pack::build`, at the revision the
# contracts pinned (freenet-prolly 9764b86). They are a DIFFERENTIAL — this
# crate's `build` has to reproduce bytes it did not author, which is the only
# way a second spelling of a format can be shown not to have drifted. They also
# reached craftworks-sdk as engine/tests/pack_vectors.txt, so all three
# spellings are pinned to one set of bytes.
#
# Lines marked LIB below them are a different thing: cases added here later,
# emitted by this crate, which pin it against ITSELF. They catch a change, not
# a disagreement. Do not renumber or re-author a VEC line — that is how a
# differential quietly becomes a self-test.
#
# Regenerate (and diff, never overwrite):
#   cargo test --test emit_pack_vectors -- --nocapture | grep '^VEC'
#
# Each line: VEC <case> <pack body, hex>
